description:
Kevin Explains delivers clear, factual breakdowns of IRS rules,
retirement taxes, Social Security, Medicare, and the financial traps
most retirees never see coming until it is too late.

Stay Ahead 📢 Be Sure To 🔔 Press The Bell Icon.

We focus on what the tax code actually does to your pension,
your IRA, your investment accounts, and your spouse’s future.
Every video turns complex tax law into simple step‑by‑step explanations
with real dollar numbers attached.

Our approach is calm, evidence‑driven, and built for viewers 55 to 80
who want to keep more of what they saved.

If you want straight answers about how the IRS treats retirement income,
when to claim Social Security, which month to retire,
and how to leave more to your family instead of the IRS —
Kevin Explains is your source.

Protect your retirement. Understand the code before the code takes its cut.
